messages:
Maya (Product): ok team — we need to lock the API + SDK scope for the Q2 initiative: structured output schemas, rerank endpoint, and tool/function-calling ergonomics. timeline: aim for soft-launch in 3 sprints. need launch criteria so eng/docs/sdks can align. thoughts?
Alex (SDK): +1. big question: breaking surface vs additive. i'd prefer additive with a migration shim in both TS+Py so we avoid a major bump. we can expose new signature `responses` but keep `completions` as wrapper for 3 months. :thinking_face:
Sam (ML Eng): rerank notes: we need a stable response field for scores (call it `rerank_scores`) and a strict embedding-dim compatibility check. also suggest parameter `rerank.strategy = 'pairwise|listwise'` so we can iterate later.
Jordan (Docs): i'll need concrete examples for both clients — 1) calling functions/tools with structured JSON schema, 2) using structured-output typed responses, 3) rerank usage + metrics example. small runnable snippets please, and a migration guide for users.
Alex (SDK): agree. propose types:
```ts
// TS suggestion (very small)
export type StructuredOutput<T> = { schema_version: string; data: T; meta?: { confidence?: number } }
export function parseStructured<T>(resp: any): StructuredOutput<T> { return resp as StructuredOutput<T> }
```
and Python typing example for docs:
```py
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Generic, TypeVar, Optional
T = TypeVar('T')
@dataclass
class StructuredOutput(Generic[T]):
    schema_version: str
    data: T
    meta: Optional[dict] = None
```
Alex (SDK): migration plan: keep old client methods (completions/chat) delegating to new `responses` under the hood, emit a deprecation warning, and add a runtime flag `enable_structured_output` so customers can opt in before removing wrapper. patch release (minor) for opt-in, then deprecate over ~90 days.
Maya (Product): launch criteria proposal (short): 1) API spec v1 locked and published; 2) both SDKs have adapter + tests; 3) docs + 3 runnable examples; 4) migration guide & changelog entry; 5) e2e + canary rollout plan + rollback hooks; 6) observability: token/cost breakdown + rerank metrics. anything missing?
Sam (ML Eng): add eval baseline for rerank quality (nDCG@10) in the launch checklist. also confirm embedding dims are part of API validation to avoid silent failures.
Jordan (Docs): i'll own the examples and migration guide. timeline: need drafts in 10 business days to sync with SDK PRs. can Alex point to example fixtures?
Alex (SDK): i'll open a draft PR tomorrow with adapter + unit tests + changelog stub. will add example fixtures: minimal schema, rerank toy dataset, and a notebook. will also add typed defs for TS client and typing hints for python.
DevEx Bot: CI build for branch alex/structured-output #432 — all checks passed :white_check_mark: (https://ci.example.com/build/432)
Maya (Product): perfect. assigning owners: Alex -> SDK impl + tests, Jordan -> docs + examples, Sam -> rerank evals. I'll coordinate rollout plan with eng-sre. next sync in 3 days to review PR progress. :rocket: 
Alex (SDK): noted. i'll include deprecation warning text for the changelog, and a short migration snippet in both TS+Py in the PR.
Jordan (Docs): adding checklist to docs repo and will post link in this thread when draft is up. :eyes:
Maya (Product): thanks — small follow-up: we should also document the semantics for function/tool calls when structured output schema is provided (how validation errors are surfaced). Jordan/Alex to pair on that.
Sam (ML Eng): +1. i can help define the validation error schema so it's easy to metric and alert on.
Alex (SDK): ack, i'll add a `validation_errors` array to the top-level structured response and ensure clients expose it.
Maya (Product): great. closing for now — see you at the sync.
